info.model: Cabinet hood, doors level with the oven tower's: a working white oak upper with a Broan PM600SSV power pack in its floor (suggested)
specs: 4' 6", from the oven tower to 6-1/2 in past the cooktop
5' 2 5/8" above the floor, 26.6 in over the cooktop (Broan: 24 to 30 in)
Two doors that open, about 52 W x 23 D x 26 H in inside, about 16 cu ft free
In a stainless liner box in the cabinet floor, centred over the cooktop side to side and front to back, 8 in duct up, one elbow, straight out the west wall
links: Video Maxwell picked: kitchen hood design
notes: Maxwell, 11/20/2026: the doors line up with the oven tower's upper doors so the row looks seamless.

Broan (PM400/600SSV install guide): bottom of the hood 24 in minimum and 30 in maximum over the cooktop; under 30 in the insert must sit in a metal liner (the stainless box); centred side to side over the burners; 8 in round goes up only.

Trade-off: the fan sits flush in the cabinet floor with no box below to hold smoke, and higher than the 24 in minimum, so it catches less on high heat than a deep hood. The heat sensor still turns it on every time.

Lined in stainless (Maxwell, 11/20/2026): the cabinet's whole underside and the inside of the lip, so no bare wood faces the cooktop (cooktop makers usually want 30 in to unprotected wood above). Worth a look at the LG installation manual too.
Keep heat proof things in this cabinet (sheet pans, boards, trays), not oils or spices.
